challenges.statement: The selected candidate contains 14 distinct interactive components on a single screen, resulting in extreme cognitive overload and decision fatigue for the customer.
Stitching 14 diverse cards, carousels, banners, metric tiles, and popups degrades the mobile viewport experience and increases scroll depth significantly, failing efficient navigation standards.

agentMessages.summary: Holding release due to component overload (14 components). The screen violates cognitive load limits and requires consolidation before user presentation.
